note: Wooded campground under tall ponderosa pine off US-16, 2 mi west of Custer and set back from the highway. Full-hookup and water-and-electric sites, tent sites, camper cabins and a retro trailer rental; two bath houses, laundry, game room and RV supplies. A two-night deposit applies over the Sturgis Rally. --Claude
